justification: Developer tooling only. The Sol cross-review script decoded git subprocess output with the OS locale (cp1252 on Windows) and aborted on any non-ASCII byte. This change decodes that output as UTF-8. No product, runtime, database, or planning-data path is touched.
values: N/A - no DB or API values are read by this change.
queries: N/A - no database access in this change.

break_it.scenario: A reviewed git diff contains a smart quote or em-dash (routine in this repo's user-facing copy and docs), so the git subprocess output carries bytes outside the cp1252 decode table.
break_it.what_happens: Before this fix the review aborted with UnicodeDecodeError and produced no findings, silently skipping the cross-review for exactly the copy-bearing diffs most likely to carry liability language.
break_it.how: All three git-invoking subprocesses now pass encoding=utf-8 and errors=replace, so any byte sequence decodes without aborting. Verified by re-running the email-result branch review that previously crashed and getting a clean HIGH finding instead of a traceback.
break_it.repro: Run scripts/cross_review.py --base origin/main on a branch whose diff contains an em-dash: before the fix it raised UnicodeDecodeError, after it returns ranked findings.

post_merge.secrets: None - no secrets added, removed, or rotated; the OPENAI_API_KEY resolution path is unchanged.
post_merge.other_repo: None - change is self-contained in this repo's scripts/ directory.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run scripts/cross_review.py --base origin/main on any branch with a non-ASCII diff and confirm it returns findings instead of a UnicodeDecodeError traceback.
